business_problem: Businesses seeking exporting or business-support guidance had to navigate website content or use site search; DBT sought to provide more specific, personalised guidance through a conversational interface.
solution_summary: DBT's business.gov.uk Webchat provides logged-in businesses with conversational answers to exporting and general business-support questions. The website embeds the agent using JavaScript and communicates with its API through a token generated by a secret. Before forwarding input, the frontend uses regular expressions to detect and redact common personal data. Microsoft Copilot Studio applies configured topics and generative orchestration to interpret each question, select a knowledge source or action, and use GPT-5 to generate a response grounded in specified public URLs; Microsoft Bing indexing supplies retrieval over those URLs. Replies include references and onward links to business.gov.uk and GOV.UK content. Copilot Studio can also POST to named business.gov.uk API endpoints for actions such as user lockout or ban. Conversation transcripts are stored in DBT's Microsoft Dataverse tenant, then moved by a daily pipeline into DBT's Data workspace for monitoring and evaluation; transcripts are retained for 90 days.

data_flow: Logged-in users submit questions through the Business.gov.uk webchat; the frontend redacts detected personal data and sends the query to the Copilot Studio agent. The agent searches specified public URLs through Microsoft Bing indexing, uses GPT-5 to produce grounded answers with reference links, and can POST to business.gov.uk endpoints for account actions. Transcripts are stored in Microsoft Dataverse, then transferred by a daily pipeline to DBT's Data workspace for monitoring and evaluation.
integration_points: business.gov.uk API endpoints for actions such as user lockout or ban
business_outcome: Provides more specific, personalised guidance than website search and gives businesses a conversational way to access existing exporting and business-support content in one place.
